integrity: The proof is self-contained; a finite exhaustive verifier is supplementary and is not used as proof of the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent strict ordinal rankings are assumed at every opponent profile.
The result concerns best-response graph connectivity, not convergence under a prescribed update order.
The finite-\(k\) formula is proved analytically for \(k\ge3\); \(k=2\) is excluded because the identity response map can also be connected.
A complete census of every rectangular-action random-game result was not established.
title: An exact asymmetric-action limit for random game connectivity
